title: fix: trust only the relay author line and label promotion PRs as infra
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Two small fixes to the issue/PR labeling bot.

- Discord-relayed issues: only whole `**Author:** … (UID: …)` lines count, and the last one is used. The relay bot appends that line after the message, so a UID typed into the message text can no longer route the issue to Dev as a team member's
- Promotion PRs (`main` → `production`) are always `INFRA`; #15347 was labelled `API` + `SECURITY` from the changes it carried

Dry run: #15347 → `INFRA`; relayed #15098 still maps to its real author.

gist.headline: The relay reads the footer
gist.blurb: The labeling bee now trusts the relay’s actual author stamp, not a UID that wandered into the message body. Promotion branches also get the tidy INFRA label they came for.
gist.summary: Updated the issue/PR labeling bot to use only the last full Discord relay `**Author:** … (UID: …)` line for author routing, and to always label `main` → `production` promotion PRs as `INFRA`.
gist.impact: Relayed issues continue mapping to their real Discord authors without message-text UID collisions, while production promotion PRs receive a consistent infrastructure classification.
